Meet Melody

Hi, I’m Melody Wilding

I’m an award-winning executive coach and the author of Managing Up: How to Get What You Need From the People in Charge. I’ve spent almost 15 years applying human behavior to the real challenges people face at work.

Now I help mid-to-senior professionals step into their professional power position, where confidence meets influence. My work has been featured in HBR, The New York Times and The Wall Street Journal, and I’ve worked with people at companies like Google, Microsoft and Nike.

Questions

Before you grab the kit

Who is this for?

Managers, directors and senior individual contributors who want to communicate with more presence in front of senior leaders.

How is this different from Speak Like a Senior Leader?

The kit is a quick, self-paced starting point: one training and the scripts to use this week. Speak Like a Senior Leader is my 8-week coaching program with live workshops and feedback.

How long does it take?

The video training is 45 minutes. You can use your first script in your next meeting.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Use the scripts, see how the room responds, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper with me.

Educational content, not therapy, medical or career guarantees. Results depend on your role, workplace and effort.

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts: talking to camera

Same setup as your reels: forest green blazer, chartreuse backdrop. 30 to 45 seconds each.

Script 1 · “Bottom line first”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most updates to executives start in the wrong place.”

Body

“We start with background, because it feels thorough. Senior leaders want the answer first: the point, then why it matters, then what you need from them. Flip the order and the whole room changes.”

CTA

“I put the template and 40 scripts like this in the Senior Leader Script Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “Point. Why. Ask.” with “Point” highlighted in chartreuse.

Script 2 · “Disagree without apologizing”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s how to push back on a senior leader without saying sorry.”

Body

“Drop the ‘sorry, this might be a dumb question’. Try: ‘Here’s the risk I see, and here’s what I’d do instead.’ It’s calm, it’s clear, and it puts you in the room as a problem solver.”

CTA

“That’s one of 40 scripts in my Senior Leader Script Kit. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to the script on screen as she says it.

Script 3 · “From Managing Up”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I wrote a whole book about managing up. Here’s the shortcut.”

Body

“The people who get noticed at work aren’t always the loudest. They’re the clearest. They know what to say in a meeting, in an update, and when they disagree. So I turned the moments that matter most into scripts you can copy.”

CTA

“Grab the Senior Leader Script Kit for $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: holding Managing Up, then talking to camera. Add “Educational content” on screen.
